notes: Ore rock S: a brown-grey rock with craters and copper/iron vein specks. Shoot it to break it into chunks. Frames are the piece turned [0, 90, 180, 270] degrees, lit from the top-left each time; loop them wrap (`wrap` = 1,2,3,4,1... ; `pingpong` = 1,2,3,4,3,2,...), the game may also rotate the node.
